risk_note: RV2 settlement + risk (B2-09gg; BR-FUND-22 申诉恢复 ②, BR-ID-36 ②; D10-1180, D10-1181). An order clawed back by BLACKLIST_CONFIRMED (CLAWED_BACK, reason BLACKLIST, only ever written by that R8) can now be the target of a registered order appeal, and a revoked appeal registers the same appeal_restore difference as the R12 path, with the rebate-history row that entered CLAWED_BACK. Handling goes through the existing platform-restore R13 unchanged. No new posting logic, no migration. Users submitting order appeals themselves is a separate identity task (B1-03zl).
